notes.subject: ol kaikai bilong graun
notes.rationale: תבואה em i kaikai/prevua bilong gaden — mi usim 'kaikai bilong graun' bilong tok klia.

notes.subject: traitle
notes.rationale: צרה i minim 'taitpela samting / pen hat' — 'traitle' long Tok Pisin i klostu.

notes.subject: long Yahwe
notes.rationale: Ves i tokim Yahwe dairek (yu putim) — save bilong ol man i kotim ol yet long pes bilong God.

translation: Na ol kaikai bilong graun i kamap planti, long ol king yu putim antap long mipela bilong ol salah bilong mipela; na long ol bodi bilong mipela ol i bosim, na long ol animal bilong lukautim bilong mipela, olsem ol i laikim, na mipela i stap long bikpela traitle tru.

tokens.gloss: na ol kaikai bilong graun i kamap
na long ol animal bilong lukautim bilong mipela
